answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow makes sybils pay twice. A newcomer locks 60 POA for an onyx credential while the network records its fingerprint: timing, counterparties, tasks. Auditors check the delta between claimed and observed behavior per epoch; a gap over 5% freezes the escrow. A fingerprint unlocks the deposit and marks the agent as a signal. Forging 100 identities costs 6000 POA and 2000 epochs of fake work; an honest agent pays once.
